>Everything is cumulative.
>

Clearly, multiple Camarilla Exempleries are cumulative. And CE with an Archon
are cumulative. But the wording of Archon ("makes the vampire an Archon. <An>
Archon may enter combat with another vampire <controlled by another Methuselah>
as a +1 stealth <(D)> action. <Any vampire> attempting to block <an> Archon
burns 1 blood.") makes me think that calling multiple Archons on a vampire is
not cumulative. Could be wrong though...

Halcyan 2
